user.title: Habit Tracker
user.description: Use a PAT with habits:read, statistics:read and entries:write. Add habits:write to create habits under Configure after connecting. HTTP is only suitable for a trusted local connection.

data.allow_http: Allow HTTP on a trusted local connection

reconfigure.title: Replace API token
reconfigure.description: To create habits from HA, use a token for the same account with habits:write in addition to the read and check-in scopes.

error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTPS URL, or explicitly allow local HTTP.
error.invalid_auth: Check the token, expiration and scopes.

abort.already_configured: This backend account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: The replacement token belongs to another account.

perform_action.name: Habit action
perform_action.description: Change a habit through an authenticated dashboard sensor.

value.name: Total value
value.description: Period total, required only for set_value.

init.title: Set up my habits
init.description: Choose a preset to customize or create your own habit. Creation requires habits:write. Existing habits stay unchanged.

preset.title: Choose a preset
preset.description: Nothing is created until you confirm the next form.

habit.title: Define the habit
habit.description: Target and step use the selected unit: mL, meters, seconds or check-ins. A yes/no habit requires count and target/step 1. Frequency targets are integers. Use an IANA timezone such as Europe/Paris.

created.title: Habit created
created.description: “{name}” is saved and appears automatically in entities and cards. Add another habit or finish.

error.write_forbidden: This token cannot create habits. Issue a replacement with habits:write, then reauthenticate the integration.
error.invalid_auth: Token expired or revoked: reauthenticate the integration.
error.cannot_connect: Backend unavailable. Retry with the same values: the creation key is preserved to prevent duplicates.
error.invalid_habit: Check name, type, unit, target, step and IANA timezone. Yes/no: count, target/step 1; duration: seconds; frequency: count and an integer target.
error.backend_outdated: Update the backend image: this version does not support guided creation yet.
error.creation_conflict: This creation may already have succeeded with different values. Check the dashboard before starting a new flow.
